Q-5178: What day of the week was 2022-03-17?

Answer: Thursday

Calculation: Jan 1, 2022 was a Saturday. March 17 is day 76 of the year (31 Jan + 28 Feb + 17 Mar = 76). 75 days after Jan 1 → 75 mod 7 = 5 days after Saturday = Thursday. Confirmed via Zeller's congruence (h=5 → Thursday).
